general_mlh_sources.title: MLH Member Event Agreement, 2027 Season
general_mlh_sources.evidence: Requires member events to permit generative AI/LLMs and use a platform supporting prize-category opt-in. MLH confirms its final prize list with organizers. Does not supply ShellHacks scoring, disclosure fields, submission cutoff, or stacking limits.

general_mlh_sources.title: MLH Standard Hackathon Rules
general_mlh_sources.evidence: Organizers may adopt or modify these rules. Earlier ideas are allowed; project work belongs in the hacking period. Earlier own project materials cannot be reused, but libraries/frameworks/open-source are allowed. Code must be public. AI assistance is permitted with disclosure. Technology, design, completion and learning have equal weight for MLH digital events or MLH categories at physical events. A two-minute video rule applies specifically to fully digital events hosted by MLH.
general_mlh_sources.interpretation: Preparation guidance; not proof of the ShellHacks 2026 overall rubric or full rules. Do not import digital-only requirements.

general_mlh_sources.title: MLH Contest Terms
general_mlh_sources.evidence: Opened document states a term ending June 30, 2026 and contains different scoring/application limits. No successor term or September 2026 adoption was established.
general_mlh_sources.interpretation: Do not use alone to settle current entry limits/scoring. This concerns a separate policy document, not applicability of the confirmed eight prize briefs.
